Hand-written sidecar fixtures for `specular_metadata::sidecars` and the Library's sidecar
import, written from the public format descriptions (Adobe XMP specification, darktable's
manual on sidecar files and duplicates, digiKam's metadata documentation, RawPedia's
"Sidecar Files - Processing Profiles", Capture One's settings key/value form). None is copied
from an app's output.
